versionNote: Shared commands appear once. Differences show Tekken 5 above DR. Edition labels identify documented coverage; only “DR only” means exclusive.

mechanics.title: Version differences
mechanics.text: DR changes commands, launch properties and recovery as well as adding moves. Check the edition shown beside a route. PS2 Tekken 5 routes are not automatically confirmed for arcade 5.1 or DR.

mechanics.title: Combo conditions
mechanics.text: Guide damage includes the complete starter. If a string only launches on its final hit, earlier hits are not necessarily guaranteed. CH starters require a counter hit. Damage ranges reflect different launchers.

mechanics.title: DR ground recovery
mechanics.text: Some Tekken 5 knockdown follow-ups can be escaped with a backroll in DR. Treat them as recovery setups unless a DR route confirms the follow-up.

comboNote: Damage includes the full starter. Earlier hits in a launcher string may not be guaranteed; CH requires a counter hit. PS2 routes are not automatically confirmed for arcade 5.1 or DR.
